newsitem.title: ISRAEL: SOCCER-SCHARF LOYAL TO SQUAD FOR RUSSIA QUALIFIER.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-SCHARF LOYAL TO SQUAD FOR RUSSIA QUALIFIER.

text.p: Israeli coach Shlomo Scharf has named a squad nearly identical to the one which defeated Bulgaria for next week's qualifier against Russia.
Israel, which edged Bulgaria 2-1 in Tel Aviv in September, faces Russia in the group five qualifier in Israel's National Stadium in Ramat Gan on October 9.
The only change in Scharf's 20-man lineup is the replacement of Maccabi Tekl Aviv defender Alon Brumer, sidelined with a foot injury, by Hapoel Haifa defensive midfielder Ofer Talkar.
The Israeli team began training on Monday.
Scharf is reported to be considering dropping forward Ronnie Rosenthal from his opening lineup due to the Tottenham Hotspur player's lack of match play in England in recent weeks.

Israeli newspaper reports said that midfielder Eyal Berkowitz, who is poised to join Southampton in England from Maccabi Haifa for 1.2 million pounds pending a work permit, may also miss the match because of a lack of match fitness.
Defenders: Felix Halfon, Gadi Brumer, Ofer Talkar, Amir Shelah, Nir Klinger (captain), Yossi Abuksis, Alon Harazi, Alon Hazan, Tal Banin.
Midfielders: Avi Nimni, Eyal Berkowitz, Itzik Zohar, Arik Bennado, David Amsalem.
Forwards: Eli Driks, Ronnen Harazi, Haim Revivo, Ronnie Rosenthal.
